description: Opt a tunnel into a 120-second ingress timeout instead of the 30-second default — for tool calls that legitimately run long, e.g. an MCP server exposed through the tunnel. Persists on the tunnel; pass enabled: false to revert to the 30-second default.

enabled.description: true for the 120-second timeout, false to go back to the 30-second default.

subdomain.description: Tunnel subdomain, from list_tunnels, e.g. myapp for https://myapp.t.pipehero.app.

name: set_long_requests
